_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "media_store_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "folder" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "album_artist" TEXT NULL, "track_number" INTEGER NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date_added" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("missing" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hidden_folders" ("path" TEXT NOT NULL, "hidden_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("path"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hidden_tracks" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "hidden_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_entries" ("playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("playlist_id", "track_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "played_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics_links" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "song_id" TEXT NULL, "manual" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("manual" IN (0, 1)), "linked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_songs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "transliteration" TEXT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "synced" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("synced" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "approved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cached_songs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "document" TEXT NOT NULL, "cached_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queued_reports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "report_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "song_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "unmatched_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" TEXT NULL, "playlist" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NULL, "song_id" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drafts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "draft" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "own_copies" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "contribution_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "song" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording" TEXT NULL, "timing" TEXT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NULL, "audio_path" TEXT NULL, "submitted_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_overrides" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "track_number" INTEGER NULL, "cover_path" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_fingerprints" ("track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data" BLOB NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "identified_songs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "track_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "song_id" TEXT NULL, "identified_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "detected_matches" ("source_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "song_id" TEXT NULL, "offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "decided_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_lookups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "queries" BLOB NOT NULL, "heard_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_fingerprints" ("recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "song_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data" BLOB NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("recording_id"));
CREATE INDEX tracks_folder ON tracks (folder)
CREATE INDEX playlist_entries_order ON playlist_entries (playlist_id, position)
CREATE INDEX play_events_track ON play_events (track_id)
CREATE INDEX play_events_time ON play_events (played_at)
